title: Gaga

description.en: A tiny 3D playroom where Taotao can explore, wander, and discover toys.
description.zh: 给陶陶的小小三维玩具房，自由走动，探索喜欢的玩具。

subject.en: Naturally crouched biscuit-colored rabbit with one colorful carrot
subject.zh: 自然蹲伏的饼干色小兔与一根多彩胡萝卜

description.en: A rabbit pauses in a natural crouch beside a carrot. The whole animal includes its ears, haunches, short forepaws and small tail; the face carries the moment.
description.zh: 小兔在胡萝卜旁自然蹲伏，完整呈现耳朵、后腿轮廓、短前爪和小尾巴，用脸部表情捕捉这一刻。

description.en: Large warm tan and cream facets keep the body soft and readable. One carrot and its colorful leaves form a single accent group beside the muzzle.
description.zh: 大块暖褐与奶油色切面让身体柔和易读，一根胡萝卜及其彩色叶片在嘴边构成单一兴趣点。

description.en: Offset rounded paper folds sit on a warm clay field. Their gentle corners and broad openings give the rabbit a tactile, quiet setting.
description.zh: 错位的圆角纸面铺在暖陶土色底色上，柔和转角和宽阔开口营造安静的触感背景。

sizeNote.en: The complete animal and accessory have at least 183.5 px clearance from the actual rounded outline. Ten export sizes preserve one uniform placement. Small app/browser marks use the transparent foreground; fine facets and accessory details simplify at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 完整动物和兴趣点距离真实圆角轮廓至少 183.5 px。十种导出尺寸保持同一组等比位置，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体；细小切面和装饰细节在 16 px 时会简化。

goal.en: Watch and guide a virtual character through a browser playroom with animated toys, camera controls, and a daily discovery journal.
goal.zh: 在浏览器玩耍空间中观察并引导虚拟角色探索玩具，调整视角并查看当天足迹。

role.zh: 程序化房间、角色与玩具

role.en: Synthesized ambient music and toy sounds
role.zh: 合成环境音乐与玩具音效
